name: @foundgine/wasm
description: WebAssembly build of the Foundgine MCP and workflow client (Rust core, ES-module wrapper mirroring @foundgine/sdk).

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/foundgine_sdk_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web --typescript
